items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I met Kaiser Marshall who was a drummer, I met O'Neal Spencer, then I met Big Sid Heard, I met Joe Jones, I met J.C. Heard, I met Face, who was Zootie Singleton

ctx.x: You know, Jimmy Mundy was going to form a band, and I stayed there -- and I would go to every -- I played all over New York, going in jamming. I remember, you know, you hear of all these drummers; you're from the West Coast, and they never did talk too much about West Coast musicians at the time, because they thought -- they had the reputation of being good readers, but they didn't think that West Coast musicians could improvise, or [tad taoud] (PHONETIC) as they called it, right?

These were drummers that I'm sure that everybody out east was aware of; thus, I met Kaiser Marshall who was a drummer, I met O'Neal Spencer, then I met Big Sid Heard, I met Joe Jones, I met J.C. Heard, I met Face, who was Zootie Singleton; and it was quite an experience, you know, to go from Los Angeles to New York.
Was Lester in New York when you were there?
